subject: Wedding guest rental
message:
I hope you’re well. I’m would like to rent wedding guest outfits for an upcoming wedding taking place from 29th January to 31st January.
We are looking to rent outfits for three people:
One adult man
One adult woman who will be 8 months pregnant at the time of the wedding (comfort and suitable tailoring are very important)
One 1.5-year-old boy
The events are as follows:
1. Bridal Mehendi
Man: Linen suit
Woman: Dress 
Colour: soft dusky peacock tones, reds, or greens
2. Haldi
Man: Kurta tops/simple pants
Woman: Saree 
Colour: yellows and/or oranges
3. Sangeet
Man: Sherwani or jazzy bandhgala jacket 
Woman: Lengha/party sarees  
Colour: royal blues, emeralds, or aubergines
4. Wedding Ceremony
Man: Sherwani or suit
Woman: Saree or lehenga 
Colour: pastel colours
5. Reception
Man: Suit or tuxedo
Woman: Ball gown or party saree
Colour: gold, silver, or copper tones
We would like to visit your shop on the 29th in the early afternoon to select all outfits and have them fitted/tailored during the same visit.
Could you please let us know:
Whether you have suitable options for all three?
Rental pricing, deposit requirements, and what is included (fittings, alterations, cleaning, etc.)?
If helpful, I’m happy to share sizing details, inspiration images, or budget ranges in advance.
Thank you very much — I look forward to hearing from you.
Kind regards,
Ruby
